message.content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "ref": "R394",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "The game can be played to make large amounts of money quickly.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "you can grind to make 80 mil in the first year :)"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R395",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that strangers cannot message or voice chat with the child, and the feature is off by default.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "I am a pc player and just downloaded SDV on my IPad thinking i could play while I’m on the road."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R398",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "The game does not allow refunds even after only a few minutes of play.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Not even able to refund while only playing for a couple minutes! Very upsetting."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R399",
      "area": "glitches",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game glitches and can reset progress, causing loss of items and days.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Deleted random items (such as cloth, horse, horse stable, mystery box), and some items have an outlining."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R400",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "Items are expensive to buy but sell for very little, creating a financial trap.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "the seeds cost about 2000 gold but sell for 50. It’s ridiculous!!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R402",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game lacks multiplayer functionality for mobile.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Please add multiplayer!!!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R403",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game lacks co-op mode for mobile.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Nice game,but we need the co-op mode"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R406",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game collects device data and may share it with third parties.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Sometimes experiencing issues when using Apple Pencil pro to move"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R407",
      "area": "glitches",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the tutorial is missing, leading to confusion and unexpected charges.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The first night I couldn’t get into my house so I passed out and then was charged 50 coins bc the medical team had to rescue me."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R408",
      "area": "glitches",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game crashes frequently, causing loss of progress.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Crashes a lot and you lose whole days."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R412",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the UI elements are cut off on iPhone 16 Pro Max, affecting gameplay.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The energy bar and health bar are too low on the screen and not fully visible on iPhone 16 pro max and there’s no way I’ve found to move them."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R413",
      "area": "glitches",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the bus feature is broken, preventing access to the desert.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I’ve unlocked the bus, but when I go to get on it there’s no option to go to the desert."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R414",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the font is too small to read on the screen.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "字体太太太太小了！字体太小！！!!!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R415",
      "area": "glitches",
      "claim": "A parent reports that luck affects fishing in a way that prevents catching fish.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "anytime I get extra luck, I can’t catch any fish that day."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R416",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports that using Apple Pencil Pro causes the game to become unusable.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "The game is unusable after using Apple Pencil pro, please consider checking. Happened several, times already recently"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R417",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that co-op is hidden and requires searching for a video to enable it.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "there already is co-op on the game if ur on iphone search up a video on how to get the secret co-op on the menu"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R418",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the mobile version lacks proper controller support and mod integration.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "手机版没有mod游戏体验太差了 做了手柄操作但是完全没有用心，明明可以直接把pc端手柄操作移植过来却非要废除右摇杆功能导致现在手柄几乎是个废物"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R422",
      "area": "glitches",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game crashes when changing regions, causing loss of the entire day's progress.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I can't play with my friend now，even can't host a new farm."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R423",
      "area": "glitches",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the energy bar is missing from the screen on mobile.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "My energy bar is off my screen entirely."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R425",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game is not optimized for iPhone 16 Pro Max, causing UI elements to be cut off.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I Have the 16 pro max and the Dynamic Island covers most of the hot bar or quest and items get cut off being so close to edges"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R426",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the app was charged again after already being paid for.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Already paid for app and they want to charge me again so don’t recommend getting."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R428",
      "area": "glitches",
      "claim": "A parent reports that cutscenes are buggy and prevent interaction.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Some of the cutscenes are completely buggy. You can see the start of them, but it’s only you and the townsperson waiting around, and nothing happens at all. You can’t move. You can’t click on anything but “skip”."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R429",
      "area": "glitches",
      "claim": "A parent reports that NPC Gus is stuck and cannot be interacted with, making the game unplayable.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Gus is stuck in his bar infront of the register on the carpet so i cant buy from him and its been days..... kinda makes it unplayable for me"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R430",
      "area": "glitches",
      "claim": "A parent reports that progress is deleted randomly, causing discouragement.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "my progress keeps being deleted and it’s sort of discouraging."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R432",
      "area": "glitches",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game randomly zooms in and becomes unplayable, requiring a restart.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I LOVE STARDEW VALLEY…issue I’m having is the game will randomly zoom all the way in and completely bug out so I have to pass out so it will save and I can restart the app"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R433",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game does not handle iPhone 16 Pro's camera island correctly, affecting usability.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "This game is not playable given the top notch of the phone covers the screen which prevents selection of items, covers dialogue and is just annoying."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R436",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports that crab traps cannot be placed on iOS, indicating a functional bug.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "ios端在海边放置蟹笼一直放不下去，已经快被这个逼疯了，什么时候能修一下？"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R438",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that controller support on iOS is incomplete, preventing full gameplay.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "The Steam/PC version of this game is perfect. The iOS port is missing some controller support. You can’t do every action off the controller"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R439",
      "area": "glitches",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game crashes to a black screen when mining, forcing a restart.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Game continues to crash every time I go mining and have to close the game to start the day all over again."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R440",
      "area": "glitches",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game randomly zooms in and becomes unplayable, requiring a restart.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I LOVE STARDEW VALLEY…issue I’m having is the game will randomly zoom all the way in and completely bug out so I have to pass out so it will save and I can restart the app PLEASSSEEE FIXXX this game is 10000/10 just app needs this bug fixed!!!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R441",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that DualSense controller buttons do not work properly on iPad, preventing interaction.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I can’t open the journal, no matter which button I press."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R442",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports that controller support is missing, causing incorrect item selection.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Would like to be able to use a backbone or controller to play this game my fingers keep selecting the wrong items even after adjusting the tool bar size"
    },
    {
      "ref": "R446",
      "area": "glitches",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the raccoon quest bug causes the app to close when placing jam.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I cant complete the racoon second quest.When I tried to put the jam the apps immediately close."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R447",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports that the game is highly addictive and can lead to excessive playtime.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "This game might be the most addicting one I’ve ever played. There’s always something new to do, or a new path to take if you ever get bored (which you can’t)."
    },
    {
      "ref": "R448",
      "area": "glitches",
      "claim": "A parent reports that progress is deleted randomly, causing discouragement.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "my progress keeps being deleted and it’s sort of discouraging."
    }
  ]
}
